reason: A strawberry cheesecake matcha or a hot chocolate with torched meringue is exactly the kind of thing I'd stop for and post, and it's right at the subway exit when I come out on a Saturday. I'd try it once, and come back if the drink of the week looks good, but I'm only around on weekends so it won't become a habit.
objection: I already have a spot I stop at on my walk, and I can't tell from a chalkboard whether these drinks actually look good on camera or are just sweet syrup in a cup. If it's not photogenic I won't come back.
